about: Nightly totals from the City of Toronto's Daily Shelter & Overnight Service Occupancy & Capacity data. headline = every PROGRAM_AREA except Temporary Refugee Response; refugee = Temporary Refugee Response. Capacity is actual capacity. Beds and rooms are separate and never added. See docs/DATA.md.

turnaways.about: Central Intake Service Queue Data: 'Total individuals who were not able to be offered a space over the past 24 hours, at time of closeout at 4am.' Singles and couples only.
